title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
ai_summary:

• The integration can lead to faster inference times and reduced power consumption for applications.
student_angle: The advancement in low-power inference could lead to more internship opportunities in edge AI.

title: Mario Meets Pareto
ai_summary:

student_angle: Learn Pareto optimization; it applies to real-world problems in various fields, including data science and AI, boosting problem-solving skills and portfolio value.
